summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on various proposals and updates, including the integration work with Spark and the introduction of new features in the Iceberg specification. Key topics include credential management for encryption, efficient column updates, and linking schema IDs to data files.
highlights: Iceberg Spark Community Sync notes on integration work and updates
Consensus on 'Complete' approach for partial updates in Iceberg
Proposal to add relative paths to v4 spec
Discussion on credential management for KMS/Vault in REST catalog
